---
title: "Butterfly System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& y+yz\\
\dot{y} &=& -xz+yz\\
\dot{z} &=& az-xy+1
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.5$ and initial condition $(2,1,1)$.
